question: In Arc 8, Subaru connects with members of the Pleiades Battalion using “Cor Leonis.” Despite being considerably farther away from his allies than he was when he used it in Arc 6, the members of the Battalion seem to become significantly more powerful. Does “Cor Leonis” have any range limitations?
answer:
There are no limitations on the effect of “Cor Leonis” once the connection has been established and Subaru moves away.

Subaru simply can't attempt to establish a connection with Cor Leonis while he's already away from them.

Establishing a connection from a distance equivalent to an entire town would be difficult, but if Subaru could pinpoint their location, he could probably establish one from within the Pleiades Battalion.

Once the connection has been established, it can be maintained indefinitely as long as Subaru doesn't fall asleep or lose consciousness.

So even though Subaru and the members of the Pleiades Battalion are currently separated in Arc 8, that would mean Subaru has traveled all the way to the Imperial Capital without sleeping or losing consciousness while maintaining the connection.

If Subaru were suddenly knocked unconscious in that state, the Pleiades Battalion members fighting in Garkla would instantly become weaker.

That would be dangerous.
